card.statement:
Let $\fb(\dot{\S})=\fh\oplus \fn^+(\dot{\S})$ be a Borel subalgebra of $\g$ induced by a system of simple roots $\dot{\S}$ of $\dot{\D}$. This Borel subalgebra induces a Borel subalgebra of $\cG$ given by

\[
\cB_\nat(\dot{\S})=\cH\oplus (\fh\otimes t\C[t])\oplus (\fn^+(\dot{\S})\otimes \C[t,t^{-1}]).
\]

The natural parabolic partition of $\cG$ is defined by $P_\nat(\dot{\S})=\{\alpha\in\Delta\mid \g_\alpha\subseteq \cB_\nat(\dot{\S})\}$. Explicitly, we have that $P_\nat(\dot{\S})=\{\alpha+n\delta,\ k\delta\mid \alpha\in\dot{\Delta}^+(\dot{\S}), n\in\Z,\ k\in \Z_+\}$.
card.label: Example 9

paper.title: Highest weight modules for affine Lie superalgebras
paper.abstract: We describe Borel and parabolic subalgebras of affine Lie superalgebras and study the Verma type modules associated to such subalgebras. We give necessary and sufficient conditions under which these modules are simple.
